d:
Tony Beets owns the dredge, but he doesn't own the land it sits on. With no government permission to operate, he faces a mountain of fines and paperwork that could bring his plans to a halt. Can Tony find a way through the legal trouble and get his dredge back to work? Meanwhile, the race for gold continues for the other crews.
Watch Gold Rush, Season 7, Episode 21, on Discovery Channel India.
